cross-session-passphrase 1.2.0 adds cross-session and parallel session awareness for AI agents.

- Enables communication and information relay between parallel chat sessions using passphrases
- Supports answering questions such as "How can another window access this file?" and "What did another session just do?"
- Improved session awareness and unique agent identification via the AI Passport Regime, compliant with 2026 industry standards
- Enhanced governance and auditing, referencing international AI governance frameworks (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST, EU AI Act)
- Updated documentation with detailed governance principles, multi-language support, and disclaimers
